data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003 provides no explicit ordering relative to the other gaps beyond labeling itself 'Test #4' and vaguely saying it is fourth because the blast radius 'is a recovery path failure.' The problem requires an ordering justified by blast radius contrasting 'what corrupts the append-only record vs what merely hides a refusal'; SRC_003 gives no comparison to any record-corruption gap or any refusal-hiding gap, so its fourth-place position is asserted, not justified.
